tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /thugs rje chen po'i bsnyen sgrub bya tshul gsal bar bshad pa rmongs pa mig 'byed lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo lo ki shwa ra ye/ thugs rje'i spyan gyis dus drug tu/ /'jig rten kun la legs gzigs nas/ /mtha' yas 'gro kun 'dren mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs dbang rgyal/ /de nyid bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /nyer mkho bsnyen pa bya ba'i tshul/ /rmongs pa mig 'byed lde mig bshad/ /chos bdag mkha' 'gros gnang ba stsol/ /de la 'dir grub chen tshem bu pa nas brgyud pa'i thugs rje chen po'i bsnyen pa bya tshul la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ yid dang mthun zhing rang dbang 'du ba'i sgrub khang du/ rang nyid kha shar la sogs par bltas pa'i mdun nam logs gang bder thugs rje chen po'i sku bris 'bur gang rigs kyi mdun stegs ras sogs bkab pa la 'bru bkram pa'i steng dkar gtor zlum po'i mdun chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ bsgul bskyod mi dgos pa'i stan gyi 'og sa dkar gyi rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i khar nas 'bras la sogs pa'i 'bru gtor de mdun cog steng rdo dril bshams/ mtshams g.yog sman pa 'tsho ba'i yo byad sogs mthun rkyen thams cad tshogs par byas la/ mar ngo'i gza' tshes dge bar sgrub khang gi nang du cha gsum yid ches par btang la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bden brdar gyi tshe/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / khyad par du yang thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ deng 'dir rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bsnyen sgrub bgyi ba la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs sogs 'dra/ de nas sgrub khang gi phyi rol tu tho dkar po btsugs la/

rang nyid g.yog bcas rdor dril yungs dkar nas spos sogs thogs nas/ thog mar tho yungs dkar gyis brabs/ gu gul gyis bdug rdor dril gsil zhing / suṃ bha ni/ hrīḥpadma ta krita sogs brjod/ 'bru dang bcas thal mo sbyar la/ ye dharma tshar gsum/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs nas/ bye brag tu yang tho 'di la rgyal chen bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa brtan par bzhugs nas bdag gi sgrub pa mthar ma phyin gyi bar du phyi'i bar chad nang du mi btang zhing / nang gi dngos grub phyir mi yal ba dang / bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ su pra tiṣṭha dang / ye dhar brjod la me tog gtor/ ston mchog dam pa sogs bkra shis brjod nas nang du log pa ni sngon 'gro'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ sngar bshams pa'i stan la 'dug nas/ thog mar brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di bya ste/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /tshem bu pa dang spyi lhas brag dmar ba/ /dgon gsar kun spangs rgyal ye gzhon seng ba/ /chos rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /theg chen dpal legs bdag chen rdo rings pa/ /sgo rum pa dang tshar chen mkhyen brtse ba/ /bskal bzang dbang rab bsod nams mchog ldan zhabs/ /blo bzang rgya mtsho rnams la༞ /mkhyen rab byams pa'i dpal dang rig 'dzin rje/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang rmor chen rdo rje 'chang / /gang gi rgyal tshab drin can kun dga'i mtshan/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /skyabs sems sngon 'gro bskyed rdzogs dngos gzhi'i lam/ /bsngo smon zung 'brel rjes kyi dge ba rnams/ /stan thog gcig tu len cing 'khyer so gsum/ /mi 'bral rtag tu bsgom par byin gyis rlobs/ /zas gos gnyid 'pho bar do nyin snang rnams/ /tha mal min par ting 'dzin rgyas btab nas/ /lha sngags ye shes rol par yongs shar te/ /rjes spyod rnal 'byong drug po mthar phyin shog

/bla ma mchog dang dbyer med 'phags pa'i zhal/ /mngon sum ston ka'i zla ba ltar mthong zhing / /po ṭa la dang bde ba can sogs su/ /bdag dang 'gro rnams thogs med bgrod par shog /gzhan yang rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku bstod gang shes bya/ mdun gyi mchod pa rnams la dmigs nas/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhūṣpe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ dril bu gsil la/ dharma ra ṇi tshar gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ skyabs 'gro'i dmigs pa ni/ gnas khang dag pa'i zhing khams baiḍūrya'i sa gzhi gser gyi mig mangs ris su bris pa'i steng / seng khri pad nyi'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sngon po rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i mtha' bskor du rnal 'byor ma tshem bu pa sogs brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba'i mtha' bskor du thugs rje chen po sogs yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa sogs sprul sku du ma/ byang sems nyan rang / mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs dge 'dun dkon mchog de dag gi thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i spangs rtogs kyi yon tan rnams ni chos dkon mchog ste skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum/ de rnams kyi sku drung / rang nyid kyi mdun du dgra 'dre byur gsum/ g.yas g.yon du pha ma mtha' skor du sems can thams cad 'khod par bsam pa ni skyabs 'gro'i gang zag rgyu 'jigs dad snying rje gsum/ dus sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ bla ma la lam 'dren/ yi dam sangs rgyas la lam ston/

chos la lam dngos/ dge 'dun la lam gyi grogs dang bar chad sel ba po zhu ba'i bsam pas/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / 'dir skyabs 'gro bzhi skor byas pa ni brjod bde ba'i dbang du byas shing don la 'gal ba med par sems te yi dam dang sangs rgyas thun mong du byas/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang dge 'dun dkon mchog thun mong du byas pas chad pa'i skyon med par bshad do/ /nyer gcig mthar thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod pas/ skyabs yul rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros bdag gzhan sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshogs rdzogs/ sku gnyis kyi sangs rgyas su gyur te rang rang gi zhing du gshegs/ skyabs yul dge 'dun dkon mchog nas bzung rim bzhin 'od du zhu/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gdan seng khri bcas 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas rang la thim par bsam/ sems bskyed ni/ thal sbyar ngag tu/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i gdan la skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas rdo rje thugs ka dang / g.yon dril bu dkur bsten cing /

dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong nas thon/ bdag gi smin mtshams nas zhugs pas sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa mā ya ma nu pā lā ya/ badzra satwa twe no pa tiṣṭha/ ḍi dho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba siddhimme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shrāe ya ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wan/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ma me muñtsa/ badzri bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa a/ nyer gcig oṃ badzra satwa a/ thal mo sbyar la/ phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud de phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gus pas sku la bdag gsol 'debs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sgrubs shig /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo yi ge hrīḥdakar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las padma dkar po hrīḥs mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ hrīḥpadma dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/

g.yas 'og ma shel 'phreng / g.yon 'og mas padma dkar po 'dzin pa/ spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis gzigs pa/ ral pa'i thor cog can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar pad zla la rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i pad dkar 'dab drug gi lte bar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hrīḥdakar po/ 'dab ma drug la mdun nas g.yas bskor du oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas gzhal yas khang dang / yang 'od 'phros bcud kyi sems can la phog pas thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur/ yang 'od 'phros pas po ṭa la nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la thim pas spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs kyis gang / yang 'od 'phros phyogs bcu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs thal mo sbyar la/ rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma rnams kyis oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las bla ma rnams 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin du gyur pas dbu brgyan/ yang 'od 'phros phyogs bcu nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad spyan drangs/ spyi bo'i 'od dpag med la thim/ yang 'od 'phros yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs rnams yi ge drug pa'i rnam par byon nas rang gi snying ga'i yig 'bru la thim par gyur/

zhes brjod cing spyi bor rigs bdag bla ma kun 'dus/ rang nyid yi dam kun 'dus/ snod gzhal yas khang / bcud thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin du gsal ba rnams/ gsal la ma 'gags pa dang / cir yang ma grub pa'i stong nyid gnyis dbyer med du ji tsam gnas par mnyam par bzhag go /de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ thog mar zhi ba'i las la bsngags pa'i phreng ba shel dung la sogs pa'am/ yang na las bzhi'i thun mong ba bo dhi tsitta'i 'phreng ba grangs tshang thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra brta ye swāhā/ ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i kha rlangs 'phreng bar phog par byas la/ dngos gzhi bzlas pa ni/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ zhes thun re la brgya stong sogs ji tsam nus pa bzla/ bzlas dmigs ni/ kun 'dus rnam gnyis snod bcud lus kyi srin bu tshun chad thugs rje chen por gsal ba rnams kyis gsung bar bsam zhing bzla ba dang / res 'ga' thugs ka'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros lus gang / sdig sgrib ngan song gsum du skye 'gyur thams cad sbyangs/ phyir 'phros sems can thams cad thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ res 'ga' sngags kyi sgra grag stong skye med la sems gtad/ res 'ga' bla ma kun 'dus nas gdan pad zla'i bar la sems gtad/ res 'ga' ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mtha' bskor gyi sngags 'phreng klog pa'i tshul du bzlas la/ 'og 'gyu skad cig kyang ma song ba bya/ gzhan yang sems bying ba dang / gnyid dro ba sogs byung na gos srab cing sngags kyang cung sgra che ba dang / sems rgod cing g.yeng na sgra chung bar bzla zhing rgyun du gong bas tshor tsam bzla'o/ /bzlas pa'i grangs spyir yi ge bco lnga man chad la/ 'bru 'bum bzla bar rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin/ rtsod ldan gyi dus su de'i bzhi 'gyur bzla dgos pas/

'di'i bsnyen tshad sa ya gnyis dang 'bum phrag bzhi yin mod/ 'on kyang bye ba dung phyur sogs ji tsam bzlas kyang legs par mngon no/ /de ltar bskyed pa'i rim pa bzlas pa bcas kyi rjes su rdzogs rim bsgom tshul ni/ spros bcas rdor bzlas dang spros med de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor gnyis/ dang po la rags pa dang phra ba gnyis las/ rags pa ni/ rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar du rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba mda' snyug tsam/ g.yas su ro ma dmar po/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po de gnyis gro sog tsam spyi bo nas sba gug pa ltar gug pa'i sne gnyis sna bug g.yas g.yon la zug pa rnams gsal btab nas/ thog mar g.yon/ de nas g.yas/ de nas dbus rnams nas rlung ro lan gsum bsal la/ de rjes g.yas g.yon gang nas rgyu ngos bzung ste/ nang du 'jug pa oṃ dkar po/ gnas pa āḥdamar po/ phyir rgyu ba hūm̐ sngon po dran par byas la/ 'byung 'jug gnas gsum ji ltar rigs pa 'phreng ba la grangs bzung / 'di tshad ldan byung na 'byung bzhi'i rlung gi kha dog mthong zhing / las bzhi 'grub pa'i phan yon yod do/ /phra ba ni de nyid la brtan pa thob pa'am/ yang na dmigs thun tsam rgyun du bsgom par 'dod na 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum dor nas/ 'jug pa 'od zer dkar po/ gnas pa dmar po/ rgyu ba sngon por bsgom zhing / mthar rlung gi kha dog kyang dor la sgra tsam sems gtad de bsgom pas rtog med ye shes skye ba sogs 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa spros med ni/ de rjes phyi nang snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi byed po rang gi sems nyid yin pa thag bcad/ sems kyang rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa las byung ba'i sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas la/ rang bzhin spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag

thun las ldang ba'i tshe phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub jo bo thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod cing 'phreng ba la kha rlangs phog pa byas la spyi bor reg lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ gong du bshams pa'i zlum gtor la chab gtsang bran/ -i mra tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs po ṭa la nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ 'phags pa'i zhal nas 'od zer phyung ste gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / thal mo khong stong du sbyar la/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ārya a wa lo ki te shwa ra ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ ma hā sa twa ya/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thad khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhna daṃ bā lingta ye swāhā/ mthar se gol gtog pa lan gsum/ arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ dril bu gsil zhing / skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/

jo bo thugs rje chen pos bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang / byams dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de rnams kyi dngos gzhi song nas/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ rten la me tog gtor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥ lag pa gnyis bsnol ba'i mtheb srin gyis se gol gtogs/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /thugs rje chen po 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ de yi sa la 'god par shog /byang chub sems mchog rin po che sogs/ byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing sogs/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni sogs/ sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig sogs/ skye zhing skye ba dang ni thams cad du sogs/ bla med bla ma'i sogs/ dril bu gsil la/ ston mchog dam pa sogs/ bkra shis kyis mtha' rten par bya'o/ /rjes spyod 'khyer so gsum dang rnal 'byor drug las/ dang po la snang ba sku'i 'khyer so ni/ thun mtshams su/ mig yul du gang snang ba thams cad thugs rje chen po'i sku gsal stong zung 'jug tu bsgom la/ snang ba tha mal du 'dzin pa spangs/ grags pa gsung gi 'khyer so ni/

rna bar sgra thos tshad yig drug tu bsam/ dran rtog thugs kyi 'khyer so ni yid la bzang ngan gyi rtog pa gang skyes kyang chos dbyings spros bral thugs rje chen po'i thugs dang dbyer med du bsgom mo/ /rnal 'byor drug gi dang po/ za ba zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ bza' btung ci yod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas/ phud mchod chang bu sogs byed kyi yod na dang / med kyang de nyid kun 'dus rnam gnyis/ cir snang thugs rje chen por gsal ba thams cad kyis gsol bar bsam la longs spyad/ gnyis pa bsgo ba gos kyi rnal 'byor ni/ gos ci 'byor 'bru gsum gyis lha'i na bzar byin gyis brlabs te/ rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i sku la gsol bar mos/ gsum pa 'dug pa gnas khang gi rnal 'byor ni/ yul lung pa gnas khang thams cad 'bru gsum gyis gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs/ gdan pad zlar mos la/ rang kun 'dus rnam gnyis bzhugs par bsam/ bzhi ba nyal ba gnyid kyi rnal 'byor ni/ srod thun gyi rjes su spyi bo'i bla ma kun 'dus la/ bdag la rmi lam mang po rmi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes par༞ rmi lam 'od gsal du rtogs par༞ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab cing snying ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pa'i rkyen gyis/ spyi bo'i bla ma 'od dpag med tshangs bug nas byon/ dbu ma brgyud de snying ka'i ye shes sems dpa' thugs rje chen po'i spyi bor bzhugs pa'i sku las 'od dmar po 'phros/ yi dam gsal bar byas/ yi dam las 'od dkar po 'phros/ bla ma gsal bar byas pa la sems gtad de/ gnyid log pas/ dang por rmi lam gang byung de/ rmi lam yin par ngo shes/ de chos dbyings 'od gsal yin par rtogs/ de la goms pas sprul bsgyur gyi sgo nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la chos nyan pa sogs la rim gyis bslab bo/ /lnga pa 'pho ba dang /

drug pa bar do'i rnal 'byor gnyis bsgom par 'dod na 'khrid yig las shes par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyi thun tshad bya tshul ni/ thog mar tshugs pa'i tshe/ dgong thun nas zhugs la yul der nyi ma ma bzhud tsam la grol/ yang dmar thag chod nas tshugs la/ gnyid mi dro tshun sngar ltar byas rjes nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal/ tho rangs nam gyi brgyad cha tsam la 'khyer so gsum ldan gyi sgo nas langs te/ skyabs 'gro nas shis brjod kyi bar byas rjes ri rtser nyi ma ma shar tsam la grol/ gtor ma brgya rtsa dang / tshe sgrub sogs byed kyi yod na 'dir bya/ yang de nas tshugs la nyi ma phyed ma zin tsam la grol/ 'dir gung tshigs bya zhing / bskor ba dang phyag sogs byed kyi yod na byas la cung zad ngal gso/ de nas thun tshugs te/ grol ba sogs rigs 'gre zhing / chos bsrung la gtor bsngo byed na dgong thun grol rjes kyai rdor sogs kyi bdag bskyed sngon 'gro'i bsdus tsam bya/ brag rdzong ma sogs bsrung 'khor gyi rigs tsheg med yod na srod thun gyi rjes la bya'o/ /mdor na 'char nub gnyis dang / phyed gnyis te/ de bzhi ting 'dzin 'jig dus yin pas/ thun mtshams mkhas pa bya zhing / de phyin brtson 'grus gang che bya/ 'on kyang thog ma nyid nas brtson grags na/ rjes su mi nus pa 'byung bas/ dang por dal/ bar du bsgrims/ tha ma je lhod je lhod la 'gro ba gnad yin zhing / rab mtshams tshugs nas ma grol bar la ngag bcad bya/ de min kyang / skyabs 'gro nas bkra shis kyi bar la tha mal gyi 'phros gtam lta ci smos/ bla ma'i gsol 'debs dang / yi dam gzhan gyi bzlas pa'ang mi bya/ ja phran bu 'thung ba ma gtogs zas gzhan bsrung gang thub bya/ gung sang kyang chab ril lta bu drung du bzhag nas der bya/ sgyid lug pa dang / mi nus pa byung na rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar sogs la blta zhing / gzhan dgos med du dpe cha 'dzin sgrogs bris rtsom sogs mi bya/

mtshams ma grol bar skra sen mi 'breg kha lag mi bkru/ stan mi sprug gnas khang la phyag dar mi bya ba sogs kyang dngos grub myur du 'byung ba'i gnad yin zhing / phyogs gzhan nas yig bskur byung na/ snga mo nas 'di phyogs nas yi ge byung na dmigs khongs su snga 'jug pa bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa gtad la/ sgrub khang gi phyir spos bdug byas nas blangs te/ mal ma yin pa gzhan zhig tu bklags te/ yig lan kyang de nas bya/ dkor zas kyi rigs la 'dzem zhing / bla ma dkon mchog la blo gtad de/ lo zla grangs sogs kyi bcad rgya ma song bar la blo gzhan du mi 'gyur ba gal che'o/ /de ltar bsnyen pa legs par them nas kha skong dang nus pa dbyung ba'i phyir sbyin bsreg bya tshul ni/ gnas de nyid dam gzhan du'ang rung ste/ sngar sa chog ma byas pa'i gnas gsar yin na der sa chog bya dgos pas/ thab stegs gru bzhi 'jim pas byugs pa'i steng / cha gsum gtor ma bsham la/ thun mtshams kyi lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'am/ yang na bdag bskyed bsdus tsam byas la cha gsum dkyus bzhin las phyogs skyong dang 'byung po'i gtor ma'i mjug gi 'phrin bcol ni/ sa'i phyogs 'dir 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sbyin bsreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ lha mchod cing sems can gyi don bgyid par 'tshal na/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ bgegs gtor la bden pa brdar bsnyen pa'i sngon 'gro cha gsum gyi skabs bzhin las mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bden pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs kyi/ sa phyogs 'dir rnal 'byor pa bdag cag la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs sogs 'dra/ gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs ba'i rjes su/ sa'i phyogs 'dir nas/ 'tshal na zhes pa yan gong bzhin las/ 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba rnams gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la/

sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig na mo badzra kro dha sogs nas/ bgegs thams cad nye bar zhi ba cig tu gyur cig gi bar brjod la/ sa phyogs yungs dkar gyis brab cing / gu gul gyis bdug la bgegs thams cad bskrad par bsam/ de nas thab stegs kyi sa gzhi lag pas bcags la/ lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos/ oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes yang yang brjod pas nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam/ yang oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes mang du brjod pas skyon thams cad bral bar bsam mo/ /gong du bdag bskyed bsdus tsam byas na/ gnas gsum bsrung zhing dge ba bsngo ba sogs bya/ sa stegs der 'dir thab bris pa'i dbang du byas nas/ sa dkar gyis byugs/ btsag dmar gyis thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la/ de'i dbus nas mtho gang zlum bskor ni thab kyi dngos gzhi/ de'i phyir sor bzhi zlum bskor kha khyer/ yang sor bzhi zlum bskor mu ran/ yang sor bzhi 'jal ba'i sa gru bzhir btab pa stegs bu/ de'i phyir sor do 'jal ba'i sa gru bzhir btab pa bri bya la mdzes tshon dang / bsgom don la stegs bu'i dpang tshad yin zhing / kha khyer mu ran gang rung la rdo rje rtse lngas mtshan par bshad kyang / phyag len la mu ran la 'bri/ stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje/ thab kyi dbus su padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar nas 'bras rdul tshon dkar po gang rung gi tshom bu/ shar lhor ting lo che ba zhig kyang bzhag kha khyer gyi steng nas 'o ma can gyi shing sogs brgyad man gyi khru gang tsam rtsig pa'am/ yang na srog chags med pa'i lci ba sogs kyis zlum por brtsigs/ rang nyid 'jig rten pa'i shar du kha phyogs la/ stan dkar po'i steng gos dkar gyon te skyil krung bcas pa'i mdun du me yol dkar po gangs ri waṃ chu ris bris pa'i rgyab/ stegs steng rdor dril bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar/ dung chos dri bzang gi chu 'thor g.yab dang bcas pa/

rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas nas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ yi dam dang me lha la zlum gtor re re/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon nas/ yam shing mar til zas mchog 'bras so ba nas/ sran ma/ gro/ dur ba/ ku sha rnams kha gos dang bcas pa bshams/ ma 'byor na yam shing / til/ mar gsum gyis kyang rung / ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ spor lde la sogs pa dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med pa 'dus bya/ sbar ba'i me ni rgyun bzhag gam/ 'o ma can gyi shing gtsub pa las byung ba la bya/ snga dro'i dus su rang nyid khrus byas la/ gsang sngags lhag chad kha bskang zhing / sdig sgrib zhi ba dang / sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi blo sngon 'gro'i mchod pa byin rlabs nas rdzogs rim gyi bar bsnyen pa bzhin byas la/ spor lde spar la thal mo'i bar du bzung ste/ ma ṇi 'dren bzhin pa'i thab la g.yas bskor lan gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ zhes pas ting lo sbar la rtswa gtsang gzhan gyis me kha gso/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs pa'i mdzub mo gnyis dang mthe bong gnyis brkyang ba byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung la/ blugs gzar mar dang bcas pa dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing / thab la g.yas bskor lan gsum byas te/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la raṃ/ bsang chu la dmigs te/ a mṛ ta nyer gcig brjod/ 'thor g.yab kyis thab dang yo byad la gtor te/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐ gis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i sogs sgrub thabs bzhin las/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dang / bsreg rdzas rnams kyang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas/ shapta'i bar so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i mthar/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya'i ngang nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhās yam shing / oṃ shrī swāhās mar/ oṃ dzriṃ swāhās 'bru/ oṃ swa swāhās rdzas thams cad bkru/

oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhās thams cad sbyangs/ oṃ bo dhi brikṣa ya swāhā/ yam shing / oṃ agna ye swāhā/ mar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye swāhā/ til/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhā/ zas mchog oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swāhā/ 'bras/ oṃ badzra bi dza ye swāhā/ 'bras so ba/ oṃ ma hā be ga ya swāhā/ nas/ oṃ ma hā ba la ye swāhā/ sran ma/ oṃ badzra ghasma rā ya swāhā/ gro/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ dur ba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ye swāhā/ ku sha rnams byin gyis brlab bo/ /yang bsang chu thab la gtor la/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgyar khru gang / zabs su khru phyed kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ las bgrang 'phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las me lha dmar po ra skyes dkar po la chibs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas bgrang 'phreng dang / g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ sma ra dang ag tshom 'phyang ba/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtsar bzhag mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab/ srin mdzub dang mthe chung lag mthil du bkug pa/ dbyug gu rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya rna ba g.yas g.yon gyi drung du g.yab cing / gdangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/

tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me'i lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra zhes re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar/ dharma ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ku sha'i chun po brgyad la/ bsangs chu gtor la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ thal mo'i bar du bzung la gdangs dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin/ /'dis bdag cag gi bgegs dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ oṃ badzra satwa a/ zhes brjod cing thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du g.yas skor du bkram/

de nas bsang chus thab la yang yang gtor la/ a mṛ ta dang / yakṣa'i sngags brjod pas bgegs bsal/ gong du bshad pa'i phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung la/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la raṃ dang / dgang blugs kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang raṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ agna ye swāhā/ lan bdun gyi mthar/ oṃ agna ye a di pya di pya ma hā shrī ya ha bya ka bya bā ha na ye swāhā/ yang de 'dra ba lan gnyis te tshar gsum gyis byon zan phul/ de nas yam shing la sogs pa'i rdzas gzhan rnams 'bul ba ni/ thog mar yam shing lag pa g.yon pas bzung / g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs nas bskor zhing / mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ bo dhi bṛkṣa'i sngags lan bdun gyis phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ye/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyer 'tshe dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shintaṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ de bzhin du rdzas gzhan rnams kyang / lag pa g.yon pas bzung / g.yas pas blangs la bskor zhing / mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas 'bul/ 'on kyang dgang blugs byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya kho nas bzung la/ mar phul ba'i mthar kha sbyar gyi ngos thab la g.yas bskor bya/ 'bul ba'i go rim ni/ mar la/ agna ye/ til la sarba pā paṃ/ zas mchog la/ sarba saṃ pa de/ 'bras la/ badzra puṣṭa/ so ba la/ badzra bi dza/ nas la/ ma hā be ka sran ma la/ ma hā bā la/ gro la/ badzra ghasma/ dur ba la badzra a yu/ ku sha la/ a pra ti ha ta rnams rdzas byin rlabs kyi skabs ltar brjod cing / bdun re phul ba'i mthar spel tshig gong ltar sbyar ro/ /yang agne sngon 'gro'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo bstod pa rnams gong bzhin bya/ mar dgang blugs gang thub nang du blugs la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ zhes brjod/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/

me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zhes pa nas/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ zhes pa yan sgrub thabs bzhin las/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ lho phyogs po ṭa la nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdor dril spos dang bcas pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ārya a ba lo ki shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang di ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ de'i mtha' skor du rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba thams cad kyang 'dzum zhing zhi ba 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang / sdud pa'i sgo nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par gyur/ zhes brjod/ yang dgang blugs bzung la/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis bsngags pa'i byon zan bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig 'bul/ 'on kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ bha ha na ye'i mthar/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba sogs kyi spel tshig dang bcas pas 'bul lo/ /de nas mchod pa rnams badzra yakṣas bsangs/ swā bhā wa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i sogs sgrub thabs kyi mchod pa byin brlabs bzhin/

sngags phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthar thal mo sbyar la/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di/ /ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang / /sems can don kun mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lo ki shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ya swāhā/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ zhabs bsil ji snyed༞ pā dyaṃ༞ me tog ji snyed dang༞ puṣpe༞ bdug spos ji snyed dang༞ dhūppe༞ mar me ji snyed dang༞ ā lo ke༞ dri mchog ji snyed dang༞ gandhe༞ zhal zas ji snyed dang༞ nai wi dye༞ rol mo ji snyed dang༞ shapta༞ ghaṇḍa ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ yam shing nas brtsams te/ bsreg rdzas rnams 'bul lugs gong me lha'i skabs bzhin la/ bcu gcig tshan pa re re 'bul ba'i thog mar/ bo dhi bṛkṣa sogs/ so so'i sngags lan gsum re dang / dngos gzhi ma ṇi kho nas phul ba'i mthar spel tshig sbyar/ ku sha phul ba'i rjes su/ til dkar nag mar rnams mdun du bzhag la/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad til nag la thim/ shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad til dkar la thim/ de ma yin pa'i sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad mar la thim par gyur/ zhes brjod cing slar yang til dkar nag mar rnams ma ṇi 'dren bzhin pas so so nas bcu gcig re 'bul lo/ /de nas bsnyen pa'i bcu cha grangs 'dzin dngos ni/ zhag bdun la/ tshugs grol gnyis cho ga tshar re/ de phyin zhag lnga la tshar gnyis re/ yongs dril cho ga tshar bcu gnyis la so sor stong kha sbyor gyi mtshams 'bul tshan bcu gcig tshan pa re re 'bul zhing / grangs 'dzin dngos gzhi 'phreng ba la bzung la mtshon byed tsam du pang du ting gnyis kyi gcig tu til bshams pa nas/

gcig tu grangs 'dzin gyi tshul du/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis rgyun ma chad pa blugs la/ stong phrag gnyis re'i rjes su thog ma til de nyid thab tu 'bul/ de rjes yam shing sogs ma ṇi kho nas 'bul ba rigs 'dra/ 'dir grangs 'dzin tshul bshad pa ni gong gi bsnyen tshad dang bstun pa yin zhing / gzhan bye ba dung phyur sogs la de dang de'i bcu cha'i grangs 'dzin rig pas dpyad la bya'o/ /yongs rdzogs grub bstun/ mar dgang blugs bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig 'bul ba gong byon zan gyi skabs ltar bya/ mchod kha gsos la/ yakṣas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs mchod pa byin rlabs sngags phyag rgya bcas kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lo ki shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro bas arghaṃ nas/ shapta rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ skyon gyi ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma dang po chab kyis bran la/ 'bul tshul bsnyen pa ltar mchod bstod 'dod gsol dang bcas pa byas pa'i mthar/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs sgrub thabs bzhin/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ sogs kyi rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥthab kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ zhes brjod cing thal ba nas srin lag g.yon pas dpral bar brkus/ yang mar dgang blugs gang thab nang du blug la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur ces brjod la/ gong me lha nyid mchod pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar bdun re phul ba'i rjes su/ byon zan bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig kyang gong ltar phul/ gtor ma gnyis pa chab kyis bran la/ yakṣas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas la/

oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma naṃ arya nutpannā twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ agne sngon 'gro'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs shlo ka gcig gi rjes su/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gi skur sprul pa/ /rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rig sngags gsung gi bgrang 'phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ghundhe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la sil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje can/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bar chad dang / gsang sngags kyi lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ yang yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ spyan 'dren gyi phyag rgya phyir bskyed la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyed kyis sgrub kyi gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrub/ /oṃ agna ye gatstsha/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o/ /de ltar bsnyen sgrub sbyin bsreg dang bcas pa'i skabs su dkar rdor grub na rab/ ma grub kyang lugs 'di la nyes pa med par bsam ste/ 'di'i rnal 'byor drug gi nang tshan zas kyi rnal 'byor gyi skabs su dkar dmar gyi tha snyad med pa ci za ci 'thung thams cad bdud rtsir bsam dgos pas so/

/'on kyang bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs su zas byung tshad mi za ba sogs spyir btang bzhin no/ /de dag gi skabs su dngos nyams rmi lam du sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags khrus byas pa sogs dang / byang chub sems skye ba sogs ni mtshan ma'i rtags su shes par bya'o/ /yang las bzhi phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid zhar byung dang bcas pa'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod na/ 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'phrin las rab rgyas las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar thugs rje chen po tshem bu lugs kyi bsnyen pa bya tshul sbyin sreg dang bcas pa 'di ni/ nged rang gi a lce drung kun dga' bsod nams bstan pa'i nyi ma'i zhal 'don du 'di lta bu zhig rtsom dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i khrid yig ngor chen dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ sa phug bla ma sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen yig 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rnams la gzhi byas/ de dag tu mi gsal ba rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma las bka' khrid thob pa bzhin rang gi blo gros kyis bcad de dpal sa skya'i gzhi thog bla brang gi shar phyogs rang gi bsam gtan khang bu bde chen 'od gsal thos bsam 'brug sgra tshal du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni nye bar gnas pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis pa 'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na/ bla ma dang dbyer med 'jig rten dbang phyug gi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ thugs rje chen po'i bsnyen sgrub bya tshul gsal bar bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
